rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something becoming visible or simply showing up.

example.english: They suddenly appear at the door.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dat6 jin4 ceot1 jin6 hai2 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this when someone or something looks a certain way from visible evidence.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 tai2 lok6 hou2 gui6 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for appearing before a court or tribunal.

example.english: They have to appear in court tomorrow.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 ting4

rows.note: Use this when a person comes before the public, especially by going on stage or taking part in an event.

example.english: It's our turn to appear on stage!
example.jyutping: leon4 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ceot1 coeng4 laa3
